non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
M3-C-N pure schema, policy, path-binding, rollback, record-chain, or receipt preflight
preservation of all accepted private evidence in place
invalidators: change to the accepted PR #237 tree, exact-head artifact, or artifact digest
artifact loss, corruption, or SHA-256 mismatch
